beats.headline: One more thing for Donut
beats.text: More than sixty seconds fully submerged without dying earns the I was in the pool achievement, an honorary mudskipper, and a Bronze I'm Wet Box, which holds another ten scrolls of water breathing for each of them. Donut's box, for some unfathomable reason, is silver instead of bronze, and she gets an additional item: a Belt of Buoyancy. It is a simple belt that wraps around her stomach and keeps her from sinking, and it only works in the water. She spends a good three minutes complaining about it, and about how she is never going back there again.
